en: The image is a black and white photograph of a man in a suit and hat, holding a cane, walking toward a bench and a wooden fence that overlooks a large body of water. The area is surrounded by trees and bushes, and the photo is framed by branches at the top. The text at the bottom, in German, identifies the place as Kolberg and mentions 'Königsitz in der Maikuhle.' There is also a publisher's name, 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen,' and a serial number.
